simple.meaning: יָגַב (yâgab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to dig or plow.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 52:16. The surrounding contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָגַב (H3009) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: יָגַב (yâgab) / H3009 is traced through Jeremiah 52:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.
